3-chat-1.tsx.notes: Align wrappers expand to the bounded list width inside the start-aligned column, so the bubble (ConstrainedBox max 260, loose) and timestamp sit on the correct edge; relies on the scroll view having a bounded width.

runtime.why: align: "stretch" on the scroll content only needs a bounded width, which a vertical scroll view passes through from any normal parent.

3-chat-2.tsx.notes: Stretch on the list makes each row full width and the per-row cross-axis end/start places bubble and timestamp; simplest correct tree of the three.

3-chat-3.tsx.notes: justify "end" makes the row main-axis max so mine reach the right edge, while justify "start" rows shrink but sit at the left of the start-aligned column; the 260 cap is on the bubble+timestamp column, which still bounds the bubble.
